description: Points a domain or subdomain at a coach's Pistachio client portal: the address record, the hostname check and the certificate check that Pistachio's hosting (Laravel Cloud, on Cloudflare for SaaS) asks for. Nothing else on the domain is touched.
variableDescription: %ip%: the IPv4 address the hosting gives for the portal. %hostname%: the hostname verification token the hosting issues (a UUID). %dcv%: the certificate validation id the hosting issues (the part between the portal's name and .dcv.cloudflare.com).
